extent.name: kreuzberg_kottbusser_tor
extent.description: Bounded Kreuzberg candidate area around Kottbusser Tor; WFS BBOX uses intersects semantics.

limitations: Footprints come from the ALKIS live layer; the source edition is the metadata revision date 2026-09-25, not a pinned data edition.
Only AX_Gebaeude features are included; AX_Bauteil parts (including parts with own storeys, Keller, and Durchfahrt) are excluded.
Coverage is bounded to the configured extent with intersects semantics and is not citywide.
gfk/bezgfk is the cadastral building function, not current tenant, ground-floor use, vacancy, or permitted business use.
aog/aug are recorded storey counts where populated; null means unknown.
Footprint area is provider-computed ground-plan area; footprint area multiplied by storeys is not usable or rentable floor area.
namlag/pnr values are cadastral Lagebezeichnungen; a Pseudonummer is not the building's own address.
Distances are straight-line distances, not walking times.
